packages.name: Char Dham Yatra 2026 — Dasara Special Offer
packages.destination: Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath and Badrinath, with Haridwar, Lakhamandal, Uttarkashi, Sonprayag/Sitapur, Joshimath/Chamoli and Mana Village
departures: Listed departure dates need updating; do not promise a batch until the travel team confirms it.
inclusions: AC transport from Delhi to Haridwar only; AC does not operate on the hills
Round-trip sleeper-class train reservation, subject to availability
Group-sharing rooms, generally 3- or 4-sharing according to group size and gender
Virtual travel manager available 24x7, included in the package details
Tolls, parking, transport taxes, fuel charges and driver allowance
Travel insurance, included in the package details
exclusions: Costs caused by natural calamities, landslides or roadblocks
Pony, doli and other trekking activity charges
Anything not mentioned in the inclusions
Government shared vehicle from Sonprayag to Gaurikund and personal cloakroom charges for luggage during the Kedarnath trek
Double-sharing upgrade: package details state an additional ₹3,000 per person for 8 nights only; Kedarnath and Badrinath remain group-sharing
itinerary: Day 1 — Delhi to Haridwar: Delhi nunchi Haridwar ki journey start chestham. Har Ki Pauri visit chesi evening Ganga Aarti chustham. Tarvatha hotel check-in, dinner and night stay.
Day 2 — Haridwar to Lakhamandal: Breakfast tarvatha Lakhamandal ki travel chestham. Shiva Temple visit chesi hotel check-in avutham. Dinner tarvatha rest.
Day 3 — Yamunotri: Janki Chatti ki velli, akkadi nunchi Yamunotri darshan kosam trek chestham. Darshan tarvatha return avutham. Pony/doli charges extra.
Day 4 — Lakhamandal to Uttarkashi: Uttarkashi ki travel chesi Kashi Vishwanath Temple visit chestham. Tarvatha hotel check-in, dinner and night stay.
Day 5 — Gangotri: Uttarkashi nunchi Gangotri ki velli darshan cheskoni, malli Uttarkashi ki return avutham. Dinner and night stay hotel lo.
Day 6 — Uttarkashi to Sonprayag/Sitapur: Sonprayag leda Sitapur ki travel chestham. Hotel check-in ayyaka dinner chesi Kedarnath trek kosam rest teesukuntam.
Day 7 — Kedarnath: Early morning Kedarnath trek start chestham. Darshan tarvatha On A Trip camp lo night stay. details prakaram trek around 22 km; camp lo common washrooms untayi.
Day 8 — Kedarnath to Sonprayag/Sitapur: Trek back chesi Sonprayag/Sitapur ki return avutham. Dinner tarvatha night stay.
Day 9 — Sonprayag/Sitapur to Badrinath/Joshimath: Badrinath leda Joshimath ki travel chestham. Hotel check-in, dinner and night stay.
Day 10 — Badrinath and Mana Village: Badrinath Temple darshan chesi Tapt Kund, Mana Village lo sightseeing chestham. Night stay Chamoli leda Haridwar lo untundi.
Day 11 — Return to Delhi: Breakfast tarvatha Delhi ki return journey start chestham. Delhi drop tho trip complete avuthundi.
packages.notes: Trip notes: Kedarnath camping has common washrooms and no private rooms. AC is available only at the Haridwar hotel; other hotels are non-AC. Guests should carry their own water bottle. Early departures apply for Kedarnath and Yamunotri, with packed breakfast. The company may modify the itinerary due to conditions. Trekking distances, transport, hotel allocation, price, taxes, departure dates and availability must be reconfirmed before booking. The package details list package price ₹23,499 + 5% GST and a normal price ₹29,999; do not promise the offer is still active.
packages.doubleSharing: Double-sharing costs ₹3,000 extra per person for 8 nights. Kedarnath and Badrinath stays remain group-sharing.

faqs.question: What is included in the Char Dham Yatra package?
faqs.answer: The package details list Delhi–Haridwar AC transport (AC does not operate on hills), round-trip sleeper train reservation subject to availability, group-sharing stays across the itinerary, 10 breakfasts, 10 dinners, sightseeing and darshans, a virtual travel manager, transport-related charges and travel insurance. .

faqs.question: What is excluded from the Char Dham Yatra package?
faqs.answer: Package lo include kaani items personal expenses, pony/doli and trekking activity charges, tips, heater charges, hot water at Kedarnath, certain natural-calamity/roadblock costs and anything not listed in inclusions. Government shared transport to Gaurikund and luggage cloakroom charges are also described as at the traveller’s own cost.

faqs.question: What services do you provide?
faqs.answer: On A Trip Holidays helps with tour packages, customized trips, hotel bookings, and flight bookings. Tell me your destination and travel dates so I can check the available package information.

faqs.question: How do I book a trip?
faqs.answer: I can help you find the right package. Please share your destination, travel dates, and number of travellers. Our travel team will confirm availability and the next booking steps.

faqs.question: Are package prices final?
faqs.answer: Package prices and any applicable taxes must be checked against the specific package details. I won’t guess or promise an unverified price. If the amount isn’t listed, I’ll confirm with our travel team. A travel expert will let you know, sir.

faqs.question: How many days is the Char Dham trip?
faqs.answer: Ee Char Dham trip 10 nights / 11 days andi. Delhi nunchi start ayi Delhi lone end avuthundi.

faqs.question: What is the package price per person?
faqs.answer: Char Dham package ₹23,499 per person + 5% GST andi.

faqs.question: How much for a child below 5 years?
faqs.answer: 5 years kanna takkuva age kids ki free andi.

faqs.question: How much for a child aged 5 to 11?
faqs.answer: 5–11 years kids ki ₹15,399 + 5% GST per child andi.

faqs.question: How does room sharing work?
faqs.answer: Normal ga 3–4 sharing rooms untayi andi. Kedarnath camp lo common washrooms untayi; private room undadu.

faqs.question: Can I get a double-sharing room?
faqs.answer: 2-sharing upgrade ₹3,000 extra per person for 8 nights andi. Kedarnath, Badrinath lo group sharing untundi.

faqs.question: Are meals included?
faqs.answer: Package lo 10 breakfasts and 10 dinners include ayyayi andi. Lunch include ani listed ledu.

faqs.question: Where does the trip start and end?
faqs.answer: Ee Char Dham trip Delhi nunchi start ayi Delhi lone end avuthundi andi. Train booking details mee boarding city batti travel team tho confirm cheyyandi.

faqs.question: Which vehicle is provided?
faqs.answer: Transport package lo include undi andi. AC Delhi–Haridwar route lo matrame; hills lo AC undadu. Exact vehicle type group size batti confirm cheyyali.

faqs.question: Are senior citizens able to do this trip?
faqs.answer: Char Dham lo trekking and high-altitude travel untayi, especially Yamunotri and Kedarnath. Senior citizens health and walking ability batti doctor advice teesukoni travel plan cheyyandi.

faqs.question: How do I book and what is the advance?
faqs.answer: Booking kosam ₹5,000 per person advance ani package details lo undi; balance departure ki 7 days mundu pay cheyyali.

faqs.question: What is the cancellation policy?
faqs.answer: details prakaram registration charges non-refundable. Start date ki 15 days mundu cancel chesthe 50% charge; 7 days lopu cancel chesthe 100% charge.

faqs.question: What are the upcoming batches?
faqs.answer: Andi, next batch ki exact date approved package data lo confirm avvaledu. Date guess cheyyakunda travel team tho confirm cheyinchali.

faqs.question: What should I carry for Char Dham?
faqs.answer: ID proof, Yatra Parchi printout, medicines, trekking shoes, warm clothes, gloves, raincoat/umbrella, charger, power bank and water bottle carry cheyyandi.

faqs.question: Can I get the package details on WhatsApp?
faqs.answer: Sure andi, WhatsApp lo details kavala? Mee WhatsApp number share cheyyandi; travel team ki details pampinchadaniki note chestha.
